RATE-TABLE GATE (3g.1) resolved for this skill: the annual licence fee is 7 licence groups x 4 year-of-road-entry bands, 849 to 5,364 NIS, captured in full into references/license-fee-table.md. The prior cycles published only a range and routed the user to gov.il, which withheld the STABLE half of the table (the lookup key: the group is printed on the LEFT of the vehicle licence) while keeping only the half that decays. Rule for next cycle: re-check the amounts each April, never re-collapse the table back into a range.

gov.il TOOLING: www.gov.il returns HTTP 403 to curl AND to headless chromium, but renders fine in `chromium.launch({channel:'chrome', headless:false})` with a normal user-agent. The fee board's accordion tabs must be CLICKED individually; one click per tab per page load. That is the only way we have found to read the fee tables. WebFetch mangles them.

THE JUDGE WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE 404s AND I WAS WRONG. Six cited gov.il URLs (test-cars-renew, kalanoit-registration, reservist-rights-iron-swords, pledges-registry-inquiry, mandatory-car-insurance, departments/units/mivchan-rishuy) are hard 404s redirecting to gov.il/he/error, not Cloudflare blocks. curl cannot tell the two apart because both look like 403/failure. Always browser-check a gov.il 403 before recording it as bot-blocked. Guessing replacement slugs is futile; harvest live hrefs from a page that already works (the deregistration service page's nav yielded car_licence_renewal, request_to_deposit_vehicle_license, exemptions_from_vehicle_license_fee and disability_parking_badge).

THE TRANSFER DEADLINE IS NOW SETTLED and should not be re-litigated: תקנה 284 of תקנות התעבורה imposes no express deadline on a private party; the widely-quoted 15 days comes from תקנה 10, a residual clause covering any required act with no stated time; the six-business-day and seven-day figures in תקנה 284(ג) bind only a בעל רישיון סחר averaging 500+ transfers a year. Never cite '15 days' to תקנה 284.

THE REPAIR ROUND CAUGHT MORE THAN THE FIRST ROUND. Re-dispatching the Expert and Judge on the REPAIR (rather than accepting the first-round fixes) found: the seizure sentence surviving in references/ownership-transfer.md after the body was fixed, a NEW false positive introduced by my own script repair, and a source_note I had written that asserted a browser verification that never happened. None of these existed before the repair or would have been visible without a second read. Never skip the re-review.

A source_note is an evidence claim and gets the same standard. I applied a blanket 'CITED URL IS DEAD, browser-verified' note to five claims after checking only four of them; m-rishuy.org renders fine and its real defect was a different one (the snippet is not on the page). Writing a verification record you did not perform is the same failure class as fabricating a figure. Check each URL individually before annotating it.

A HEDGE IS NOT A FIX IF THE CONSEQUENCE STILL PRINTS. The script's reg-date path was made to report POSSIBLY OVERDUE, but it still printed the shekel penalty band and 'even one day expired is an offence' underneath, so a compliant owner whose licence expiry simply sits more than 30 days after their registration anniversary got accused with a number attached. When downgrading a claim to uncertain, suppress everything downstream that assumes it is certain.
